## Summary

I have successfully implemented issue #44 "Create a favicon for todo list" by making the following changes:

### Files Changed:

1. **Created `/workspace/todo-api/public/favicon.svg`** - A new SVG favicon file featuring a blue background with a checklist icon (three todo items with two checked and one unchecked), designed to match the todo app theme and the accent color (#2563eb) from the app's color scheme.

2. **Modified `/workspace/todo-api/public/index.html`** - Added a favicon link reference in the `<head>` section:
   ```html
   <link rel="icon" type="image/svg+xml" href="/favicon.svg" />
   ```

### Why These Changes:

- The **SVG favicon** provides a crisp, scalable icon that represents the todo list functionality with a recognizable checklist design
- The **favicon link** in the HTML head makes browsers recognize and display the favicon in tabs, bookmarks, and address bars
- The solution uses scalable SVG format which works well at any resolution and matches modern browser practices
- The dev server already has SVG MIME type support configured, and Vercel's static file serving will automatically serve the favicon in production
- All existing tests pass without modification

The favicon will now display in users' browser tabs and bookmarks when visiting the Talos Todo application.
